Hire suitable candidates fast on MyJobMag without stress

Avoid wasting time searching for qualified and suitable candidates - post your job advert or engage our expert recruiters and get your positions filled. We guarantee maximum Return on Investment.

View Plans and Pricing

Why Choose Us As Your Recruitment Partner?

  • Quality Candidates

    Get great and interested candidates for your open positions

  • Delivery Time

    Your time is valuable, hence, we send you only candidates that are worth your time.

  • Proven Experts

    Our team knows exactly how to spot the best people for any role.

  • Excellent Delivery

    We give you great value for your time and money.

Featured Job Posting

With featured job posting, you get x3 visibility on your job advert as we will feature it on our website home page plus other premium locations. We simply ensure that the right candidates get to see and apply for your positions.
AI CV Ranking:
Our AI saves you time by ranking the CVs you receive against your job description. This saves you time going through random unqualified CVs.
SCREENING QUESTIONS:
Our screening question feature enables you to set some questions while posting your job. The system will filter most qualified candidates for your job advert.
ONLINE ASSESSMENT:
Our assessment feature will help you to easily identify qualified candidates for the role. We have prebuilt assessments for you to choose from.
View Plans

Candidate Search

Handle your recruitment process by yourself. Search and select the most qualified candidates from our database of active jobseekers.
View unlimited candidate profiles at no cost.
View contact details of only candidates you are interested in.
Get Started

Let's Shortlist for your company

We have the expertise, experience and data required to shortlist diverse roles in your Organization. Our delivery time is quick based on the availability of prescreened candidates for certain roles. We will send you 8 - 10 candidates that match your job description in 5 business days. Over time, the companies we have hired for record high-retention rate with candidates recruited.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  • What type of staffing solutions do you offer?

    We offer a variety of staffing solutions for companies including Executive Search, Graduate Recruitment, Student Talent Hunt, and Blue Collar Hire.

  • Which industries do you recruit for?

    We recruit across industries and boundaries. This is because we have a team of recruiters who are specialists in different industries and niches.

  • Is your agency an equal opportunity employer?

    Yes, we don’t discriminate based on age, race, or gender.

  • Do you provide permanent or temporary placements?

    We help businesses to recruit both permanent and temporary staff.

  • As a company why should I use your recruitment company to find talent?

    We have a recruitment team that will guide you and help you during the whole process. With us, your recruitment needs become better defined. The process is completely tailored to build the team that will make your company thrive.

  • Can your agency help me hire expatriates?

    Yes, we help businesses and companies hire expatriates. You can place your request here and a consultant will get in touch with you: https://www.myjobmag.co.ke/recruitment#emp-contact

  • How do I start if I want your agency to recruit talents for my company?

    Awesome. We are glad that you have chosen to work with us as your recruitment partner. Please go here to submit your request and a consultant will contact you https://www.myjobmag.co.ke/recruitment#emp-contact
